meta.price_timing: Coin Metrics PriceUSD for date D = reference rate at 00:00 UTC of D+1, so return day D = UTC calendar day D

chosen.name: eth|tom|L3F3|in
chosen.description: Hold ETH only on the last 3 and first 3 days of each month; cash otherwise.
chosen.selection: max TRAIN Sharpe over the whole grid
chosen.lag_note: Calendar rules need no information, so weights are built for the execution lag. 'same_weights' re-runs the lag=1 weights with another lag, i.e. one day early (lag 0) or late (lag 2) relative to the intended slice; 'realigned' rebuilds the weights for lag 0 and is identical exposure by construction.
